question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT d.year, c.constructor_id, MAX(ds.points) as best_driver_points
    FROM drives d
    JOIN races r ON d.first_round = r.round AND d.year = r.year
    JOIN driver_standings ds ON d.driver_id = ds.driver_id AND r.race_id = ds.race_id
    JOIN constructors_ext c ON d.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    GROUP BY d.year, c.constructor_id
),
constructor_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, cr.constructor_id, MAX(cr.points) as best_constructor_points
    FROM constructor_results cr
    JOIN races r ON cr.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cr.constructor_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT dp.year, dp.constructor_id, 
           dp.best_driver_points,
           cp.best_constructor_points,
           (dp.best_driver_points + cp.best_constructor_points) as combined_points
    FROM driver_points dp
    JOIN constructor_points cp ON dp.year = cp.year AND dp.constructor_id = cp.constructor_id
),
top_constructors AS (
    SELECT c.name, c.constructor_id, MAX(combined_points) as max_combined_points
    FROM combined c2
    JOIN constructors_ext c ON c2.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    GROUP BY c.name, c.constructor_id
    ORDER BY max_combined_points DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT tc.name, tc.constructor_id, tc.max_combined_points,
       STRING_AGG(c.year, ', ' ORDER BY c.year) as years_with_max
FROM top_constructors tc
JOIN combined c ON tc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id AND c.combined_points = tc.max_combined_points
GROUP BY tc.name, tc.constructor_id, tc.max_combined_points
ORDER BY tc.max_combined_points DESC
